Q1
Which concrete improvement do you want in this repository?
Choices:
A. Fix a bug/regression in a specific workflow, script, or file; include the exact path or workflow/job name and the failing behavior. (RECOMMENDED)
B. Improve reliability/safety/observability in a specific workflow, script, or file; include the exact path or workflow/job name and the pain point.
C. Reduce runtime/cost/noise in a specific workflow, script, or file; include the exact path or workflow/job name and what is too slow/expensive/noisy.
D. Improve documentation/README/operator guidance only; include the exact file or section.
Q2
What evidence should be used to verify the change is complete?
Choices:
A. A specific failing workflow run, log symptom, or reproducible problem is resolved; include a link, snippet, or steps. (RECOMMENDED)
B. A specific before/after behavior is achieved; state the expected result clearly.
C. A measurable target is hit; state the metric or reduction goal (for example runtime, API calls, alerts, or manual steps).
